title: Abba bar Bar Chana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says this is how Rabbah bar Bar Chana is consistently named in the Jerusalem Talmud: his name was Abba, as explicitly stated, he says, in [Bava Batra 75a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.74a.2).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The repeated Abba naming and the Bava Batra proof are Hyman’s claims, not results of a new whole-corpus count.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=65&lang=en) also gives 75a. The link leads to the actual line on 74a, where the speaker plays on “every Abba” and “every bar bar Chana.” [Rashbam’s first comment there](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashbam_on_Bava_Batra.74a.2.1) explicitly equates Rabbah bar bar Chana with Rabbi Abba bar Chana. This explains the name argument. Hyman’s frequency claim about the Yerushalmi remains his own.
